acquisition method: The LTQ-Orbitrap Velos was operated in data-dependent acquisition mode with the XCalibur software.
alkylation reagent: were reduced with DTT and alkylated with iodoacetamide.
cleavage agent: proteins were digested in solution by addition of 2% of trypsin overnight.
fragmentation method: The 20 most intense ions per survey scan were selected for CID fragmentation
instrument: coupled to an LTQ-Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany).
ionization type: ESI-TRAP was chosen as the instrument
labeling: evaluate bioinformatic pipelines for label-free quantitative analysis
reduction reagent: were reduced with DTT and alkylated with iodoacetamide.
